memories.abstract: BlockBlast is a HungryStudio casual game, part of BBC project, one of four live games in Starlink repo; backend BBC; hfrog service shared with BlockCrush; 14 dev envs; prod UCloud->Aliyun RDS migration; 4 prod RO nodes; pgpour/Kafka CDC; solution_ai_mark_id int schema; fakeuser; Jenkins /tmp disk issue.
memories.body:
# BlockBlast

## Overview
- BlockBlast is a successful casual game by HungryStudio, part of the BBC project and one of the four live games in the Starlink repo. It is a standalone Starlink game (not in the Nebula series) and is in the user's infrastructure scope at HungryStudio; the user works on its data pipelines.
- Production backend is the BBC service. It provides the hfrog artifact service shared with BlockCrush; hfrog is also used by lhh-blockcrush. BlockBlast hosts hfrog in production with its own database prd_blockblast_hfrog on blockblast-prod RDS.
- prd_blockblast_client (BlockBlast) is a separate game database with a different schema (~120 tables); it is not part of the Nebula 5-DB set.

## Environments
- 14 named dev environments: dev, kwd, yy, yl, cyx, hyx, lxy, lby, mx, dwb, lgh, lhh, lsx, wz.
- LHH environment: lhh-blockblast.hs99.vip; LSX environment: https://lsx-blockblast.hs99.vip with Redis at starlink-dev-uc.hs99.vip:31000 DB0.
- blockblast is a service in the starlink-alpha stack; blockblast has dwb and lby instances, among others.
- Many environments (dwb, lby, dev, kwd, lgh, lhh, lxy, cyx, mx, hyx) use fakeuser for user auth. fakeuser exposes /fakeuser/users since image main-b2394645 (2.0); older image main-6773fc85 lacks it.
- Each BlockBlast dev stack on archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one has a BBC env file at /data/starlink-<namespace>-blockblast/config/bbc/env.dev, mounted to /app/envs/default/.env.dev in the container. The host runs the 14 dev namespaces above; these files are root-owned and require sudo to edit.

## Production infrastructure and migration
- Old UCloud PRD app servers: starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1 (10.9.79.254) and app-2 (10.9.164.112); egress IPs 106.75.x, accessed via gg profile. Source host for prod deployment: 10.9.79.254.
- New Aliyun PRD app servers: archteam-starlink-blockblast-app-1/2/3 (10.100.30.117/118/119) / archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3. BlockBlast has dedicated read-only endpoints on Aliyun.
- PRD infra runs on Starlink hosts (app, ro, n8n, alpha nodes). Production backends are being migrated from UCloud to Aliyun; Starflow service is part of this migration. Migration uses a UCloud jumpserver at 106.75.24.230 for SSH.
- Production PostgreSQL is migrating from old UCloud databases hs_client_db (~14 GB) and hs_code_keeper_db (~9 MB) to Aliyun RDS instance pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4 (account caikuai-cn): host archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com, RO host archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com, port 5432, databases prd_blockblast_client and prd_blockblast_codekeeper. PRD also uses prd_blockblast_hfrog on the same RDS.
- As of 2026-05-27, blockblast project family still had activity on the old database.

## Read-only nodes and pgpour
- BlockBlast production has 4 read-only nodes in JumpServer:
  - archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro-1 (10.100.0.31)
  - archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro-2 (10.100.0.56)
  - archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro-3 (10.100.116.171)
  - archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro-4 (10.100.0.37)
- The prod RO tier runs only bbc and gql services; no starflow/hfrog/OTLP; data path is /data/starlink-blockblast-prod.
- Production pgpour config is deployed on archteam-starlink-pgpour-prd-all-in-one at /data/starlink-blockblast-pgpour-prod/.
- Prod pgpour reads PostgreSQL archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com (db prd_blockblast_client, user starlink_user, publication bbc_publication) and publishes to Kafka topics prefixed starlink.blockblast.prd.
- The prod pgpour env file contains the PostgreSQL password; treat it as sensitive and never commit it to git.
- Prod pgpour has no CDC for solution_history or solution tables; its only solution-change channel is the BI outbox topic _kafka_message_bi_solution with source_type=solution.
- CDC pipeline 18977 is consumed by pgpour; PRD BI solution uses Outbox to message table to pgpour to Kafka. pgpour prod pipeline uses image tag main-2ce47744.
- BlockBlast production's Nginx JSON access log format does not include $http_cookie.

## Deployment and observability
- The blockblast application stack is deployed at starlink-alpha.youxi123.com, runs 12 containers, and uses openresty as its reverse proxy.
- Prod .env is identical across the Aliyun hosts: APP_ID=block-blast, HOST=starlink.youxi123.com, image tags, fixed service ports 20000-20011.
- docker-compose uses images from registry.hs99.vip/starlink/bbc and sends OTEL metrics to host.docker.internal:24318.
- Prod BBC logs are shipped from 5 hosts: archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3, archteam-starlink-blockblast-prd-ro-1, and starlink-prd-blockblast-ro-1.
- Known issue: prod BBC RO hosts have OTEL exporter connection failures to localhost:4318/v1/metrics.
- Jenkins jobs (alpha, lby, lxy) write ~1.3G DB dumps to /tmp on uc-devops-jenkins and never clean them up, causing recurring disk pressure.

## Data, integrations, API
- external_system configuration includes services: admarket, n8n, hfrog, user, bbc, automated_testing, mainstream_automated_testing, publish_platform_gp, publish_platform_ios.
- API access: /api is open (no key required); /gql/ is restricted to key-auth + ACL with consumers liguanghui, starorigin, bi, etc.
- Employee DingTalk ID lookup uses prd_blockblast_codekeeper.avatar (username and DingTalk staffId) and prd_blockblast_client.uums.yunxiao_member_bind (DingTalk binding fallback).

## Database schema
- In the BlockBlast client database family (prd_blockblast_client, alpha_blockblast_client, and dev clones in lgh/lhh/lsx/wz), public.solution.solution_ai_mark_id is integer (INT4), nullable, with an FK to solution_ai_marks(id).
- solution_ai_marks uses a serial id; the BBC flow writes integer IDs back into solution.solution_ai_mark_id.

memories.abstract: Kafka topic `cehua-ai-platform.creative-ideas` (3 partitions, key=relation_id; fields feature_key, review_result, expected_first_launch_batch, idea_priority, url_doc, follower arrays) is the legacy cehua creative-ideas ingestion topic, replaced Aug 2026 in starlink-lgh-blockcrush; Vector sink table `_cehua_ai_platform_creative_ideas` stores cehua + pm_enriched rows, unique on (topic,partition,data_offset).
memories.body:
# cehua-ai-platform creative-ideas

## Kafka topic
- Topic name: `cehua-ai-platform.creative-ideas` (production topic / legacy cehua creative-ideas topic).
- Exists on the prod Kafka cluster and the starlink dev Kafka cluster; dev Aliyun cluster `ukafka-1lx9ho1ce186`, brokers `10.9.169.2:9092`, `10.9.131.68:9092`, `10.9.103.246:9092`; 3 partitions.
- Carries creative-idea review events published by the 策划 AI 平台 (Cehua AI Platform) / AI workbench platform.
- Message key always equals `relation_id`.
- Message fields: `feature_key`, `relation_id`, `review_result`, `expected_first_launch_batch`, `idea_priority`, `url_doc`, and `follower_avatar_name` / `follower_avatar_id` / `follower_avatar_workcode` arrays.
- A legacy topic name spelled `cephua-ai-platform.creative-ideas` also exists on dev (RF=1) and prod (RF=3). The old topic has been compacted, leaving only message `000405` on partition 2.

## Postgres sink / Vector pipeline
- Destination table: `_cehua_ai_platform_creative_ideas` (PostgreSQL, `lgh_blockcrush_client` database).
- Kafka→Postgres projection table with flattened `payload_*` columns; final landing table for the union of `cehua` and `pm_enriched` creative-ideas data; used as the template for the `_pm_idea_details_enriched` pipeline.
- Fed by two Vector configs: `cehua-ai-platform-creative-ideas-kafka-to-postgres.toml` and `pm-idea-details-enriched-kafka-to-postgres.toml`.
- Also the destination table in `dwb_mjwd_client` and `dwb_blockcrush_client`; in `lgh_jdmj_client` it is fed by `starlink.jdmj.lgh.cehua-ai-platform.creative-ideas` (source='cehua') and `starlink.jdmj.lgh.public._pm_idea_details_enriched` (source='pm_enriched'); written across all four starlink databases.
- Postgres sink unique constraint: `uq_cehua_ai_platform_creative_ideas_kafka_pos` on `(topic, partition, data_offset)`; consumed records are stored keyed by those fields.
- Flattened table caveats: no `review_stage` or `action` columns (those exist only in the payload jsonb); `payload_idea_priority` exists but the Vector config hardcodes it to null instead of mapping Kafka `idea_priority`.

## Events
- 2026-08: `cehua-ai-platform.creative-ideas` was replaced as the previous ingestion topic of the `starlink-lgh-blockcrush` cehua-ai-platform creative-ideas pipeline.

memories.body:
# Jenkins

## Overview
Jenkins is the CI/CD tool managed by the user at HungryStudio, used for builds, deployments, database syncs, migrations, and database restoration. It supports Linux, Windows, and iOS agents. It is a common MCP tool.

## Instances
- **Primary instance** (also known as `uc-devops-jenkins` or `archteam-starfamily-jenkins-master`):
  - Web URL: https://devops-jenkins.hs99.vip
  - Master host: 10.100.27.205 (internal network)
  - Egress IP: 111.200.218.82 (used for callbacks to Starlink)
  - Build executor runs on host `mbhpacker1`
  - Runs on a g7/hfg7 ECS instance with PostgreSQL 16.14 tools
  - Used for BBC builds, database syncs, PostgreSQL dump/restore, backup scripts, migration attempts, hs-devops pipelines, starorigin deployments, starlink deployments, BBC/frontend/GQL deployments, merge/TapTile apps, and more.
- **devops-jenkins.hs99.vip** (Rocky Linux 9.7, x86_64) – used for starlink, starorigin, toolhub deployments, and db-migrator playbooks. Hosts jobs under the `starorigin419` folder and starlink/ding jobs. Also hosts the StarOrigin 419 Jenkins server.
- **Additional instances for BlockBlast PRD**:
  - Main: 10.254.144.112:8181
  - 中台: 10.9.94.63:15050
  - 星链: starlink-jenkins.hungrystudio.pp.ua:8181
  - iOS/mbh: mbhpacker1.youxi123.com:8080

## Build Jobs
- 11 build jobs: `bbc`, `frontend`, `lowcodegql`, `pgpour`, `rustyme`, `starflow`, `feworkgql`, `ding`, `gql`, `fakeuser`, `hfrog`. All push images to both `registry.hs99.vip` and `starfamily-registry-vpc.cn-beijing.cr.aliyuncs.com` (same path and tag).
- **starlink folder** contains 21 `-build` jobs (e.g., `bbc-build-tiger`, `frontend-build-tiger`, `gql-build`) that build and push Docker images.
- Build and deploy jobs are separated; NEBULA builds can deploy to multiple games.
- 60+ near-identical deploy Jenkinsfiles exist (e.g., `bbc-deploy`, `bbc-deploy-next`).

## CI/CD Pipelines
- Starlink project pipelines point to `starlink/solutionhub` and `starlink/hs-code-keeper`.
- Production job `prod_starlink-pm` exists for starlink; no test job for starlink.
- Starlink frontend build Jenkinsfiles live at `hs.projects/hs-devops/jenkins-pipeline-scripts/starlink/jenkins-jobs/frontend/frontend-build/`.
- Jenkins runs the starlink deploy and db-migrator playbooks, connecting to `starlink-dev-internal.hs99.vip` as root.
- A `sync-envs` job syncs deployment configs from the hs-devops repo to ACK clusters.
- Jenkins syncs data from prd to alpha but does not include schema changes.
- Used to run `helmfile apply` for starlink-bbc deployment and helmfile releases (e.g., `helmfile-173`) for starlink environments.
- Pipelines build and publish starlink Helm charts to OCI (including a `build-charts` job).
- Uses `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-prod` credential for `ack-starlink-prod` cluster (mapped from `cluster: ack-starlink-prod` in `env-values.yaml`), running deploy jobs `bff-deploy`, `attachments-deploy-k8s`, and `feworkgql-deploy-k8s`.
- Sends package-update callbacks to Starlink from egress IP 111.200.218.82.
- Uses a shared Groovy library to report job state to Starlink.
- Holds `nebula_app_ids` defining the full Nebula game family.
- Jobs are organized under folders: `starorigin-mcps`, `aigateway/astra`, `starlink`, `star-maxcompute`.
- `aigateway/astra` contains restart jobs; each job's `scriptPath` points to the corresponding starastra path in the repository.
- `starorigin-mcps/star-maxcompute/star-maxcompute-deploy` job exists.
- `ai-diagnostics-and-notify-when-failure` job: Jenkinsfile at `hs-devops/jenkins-pipeline-scripts/misc/jenkins-jobs/ai-diagnostics-and-notify-when-failure/Jenkinsfile` contains `jenkinsUserToDingTalkUserId` mapping.
- Database dump/restore folders exist.

## Credentials & Security
- Stores kubeconfigs as `FileCredentialsImpl` (Secret File) for GKE clusters (starorigin-prod Autopilot, starorigin-dev Standard Zonal asia-northeast1-b) and Alibaba ACK clusters (starorigin dev/prod, starfamily devops, aigateway dev/prod), used by the hourly ping-clusters job and deploy pipelines.
- Registered credentials include:
  - `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-dev`
  - `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-prod`
  - `hs-devops-infra-sops-age-key`
  - `liguanghui_ssh_key_at_git_7k7k_com`
- Jenkins agent has its own credentials for `starfamily-registry` (unaffected by local Mac keychain issues).
- Has an age key for decrypting SOPS-encrypted secrets; jobs decrypt `*.enc.yaml` files in-place with `sops -d -i` during deployments. This age key is a SOPS recipient for starlink deployments (alongside admin key).
- `gcloud` and `gke-gcloud-auth-plugin` are not installed on the Jenkins host.
- Wrapper job's `build` step queues the downstream job as the Jenkins controller, so a user with Job/Build on the wrapper does not need permission on the underlying job. This bypass only applies when users trigger the wrapper; direct triggering of the downstream job still requires Job/Build on that job.
- Jenkins is Starlink's execution layer with TOTP protection, running jobs such as `db-migrator`, `deploy-multiapp`, and `env-sync`.

## Database & Backup Operations
- Backup scripts installed at `/data/backup-postgres/prd-blockbloom/dump-starlink-db.sh` and `/data/backup-postgres/alpha-blockbloom/dump-starlink-db.sh` on Jenkins.
- `backup-all.sh` auto-discovers all `dump-starlink-db.sh` scripts.
- Jenkins stores sync logs and dumps at `~/jdmj-sync-from-crush/`.
- PostgreSQL dump/restore runs on the Jenkins master `archteam-starfamily-jenkins-master`.
- Jenkins x86_64 agent runs dump-and-restore Ansible playbooks.

## Migration Issues
- Jenkins at `10.100.27.205` performed migration from MinIO across a cross-VPC link, achieving ~47 KiB/s.
- Migration logs show 425 unexpected EOF errors and many connection reset by peer errors when downloading from MinIO; Jenkins cannot reliably download objects cross-VPC from MinIO and could not finish large file transfers.

## Miscellaneous
- Jenkins caches the last parameter definitions, so parameter dropdowns only repopulate after a build runs with the updated Jenkinsfile.
- Jenkins manages image tag versions in `versions.yaml` files.
- Jenkins is a common MCP tool used by the user.

memories.abstract: Starlink is HungryStudio's game configuration and A/B testing platform, spanning ~14 environments and multiple games, with services like BBC, GQL, and Ding, running on Aliyun ACK and Docker Compose, using PostgreSQL, Kafka, and MinIO/OSS.
memories.body:
# Starlink (星链) Platform

## Overview
- Starlink is a game configuration management and A/B testing platform at HungryStudio, supporting creative idea proposal/review, feature management, development pipelines, and multi-environment deployment.
- It spans multiple games: BlockCrush, BlockBlast, Mahjong Wonders (MJWD), JDMJ, Merge, Taptile, SandCrush, etc. (grown from 3 to 10 games).
- There are ~14 environments (dev, alpha, prod, and per-developer environments like lgh, dwb, lby, etc.) and ~14 services per environment.
- The user is the primary SRE and super admin (role 888) for the platform.

## Infrastructure
- Runs on Alibaba Cloud ACK managed Kubernetes clusters: `ack-starlink-dev` and `ack-starlink-prod`.
- Deployment is dual-paradigm: ~95% Docker Compose on VMs (under `/data/starlink-{ns}-{game}/`) and a growing K8s/Helmfile path on `ack-starlink-dev` backed by `starlink-deployments-*` Git repos.
- Production ECS hosts (cn-beijing, VPC `vpc-2zend6u9m5lfge18s9b0m`, Rocky Linux 10.2, Docker CE 29.7.2, Compose v5.4.0):
  - `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-1` (10.100.116.202)
  - `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-2` (10.100.143.39)
  - `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-1` (10.100.116.201)
  - `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-2` (10.100.143.38)
- BlockBlast app hosts: `archteam-starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1/2/3` (10.100.30.117–119).
- Alpha environment: `archteam-starlink-alpha` (10.100.95.238), served at https://starlink-alpha.youxi123.com via Aliyun SLB 101.201.239.158.
- Dev all-in-one host: `starlink-dev-internal.hs99.vip` (10.100.64.132), alias `aa.t.hs99.vip`, accessed as `osadmin` with key `~/hungrystudio/c.ssh-keys/jumpserver-osadmin`.
- Production hosts use `osadmin` (UID/GID 100000) with passwordless sudo and SSH key access; Docker network `starlink_network`.
- Dev host `archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one` (10.100.48.251) runs ~300–383 containers for many team members, pulling images from `registry.hs99.vip/starlink`.
- Worker nodes: 10.100.30.177 and 10.100.50.218 (containerd 2.1.6).

## Services & Components
- Core services: `bbc` (Python write backend), `gql` (Rust GraphQL read API, also `wirerope-gql`), `frontend` (SolutionHub), `ding` (OpenResty gateway), `starflow`, `hfrog`, `pgpour` (CDC), `vector`, `redis`, `starlai`, `fakeuser`, `rustyme`, `staroriginweb`, `openresty`, `nginx`, `asyncmon`.
- Frontend apps: block-blast, block-mahjong, mahjong-wonders, block-crush.
- BFF service listens on port 3100 with `/health` endpoint.
- Sentry deployment: `starlink-sentry`; Airflow production: `starlink-airflow-prd`; MinIO registry: `uc-starlink-hfrog-minio-registry`.
- API endpoint: `POST /flow/v1/yunxiao/links/tag/async-update` for flushing Yunxiao tag info.
- Data pipeline: Postgres → Airflow → Starmap.

## Databases
- Each Starlink cell has two PostgreSQL databases named `{env}_{game}_client` and `{env}_{game}_codekeeper`, hosted on the dev all-in-one RDS instance `starlink-dev-all-in-one.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (PostgreSQL 16.13).
- Production BlockBlast RDS: `pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (VPC IP 10.100.94.245:5432, DNS alias `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`), databases `hs_code_keeper_db` and `hs_client_db`; superuser `postgres`, app user `starlink_user`.
- Read replicas: `pgr-2ze00ogh570nd336` (alias `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`) and `pgr-2zee76956a0bqp6f`; five active logical replication slots.
- Old UCloud PostgreSQL at 10.9.177.238:5432 still in use as of 2026-06-25; hosts `hs_client_db`, `hs_code_keeper_db`, `n8n_alpha_db`, `hs_frog`, `n8n_db`, `starl_ai_db`, `hs_staff_db`; only `hs_client_db` and `hs_code_keeper_db` migrated to new RDS.
- Blockcrush client family: each client has its own DB (e.g., `dwb_blockcrush_client`, `lsx_blockcrush_client`, `mx_blockcrush_client`, `yl_blockcrush_client`, `lgh_blockcrush_client`).
- Nebula PRD client DB: `starlink_stp_client` on shared-services RDS.
- Operation DB: `starlink_hs99_vip_codekeeper`.
- Shared-services RDS: `archteam-starlink-prd-shared-services.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, database `fework_prd_db` with tables `app_group`, `app_info`, `app_login`, `release`, `work`.
- Merge RDS instance `pgm-2zehh591176h9svz` hosts `prd_merge_client` and `prd_merge_codekeeper`.
- Credentials stored in `e.credentials/starlink/` (e.g., `shared.txt`, `blockblast.txt`, `merge.txt`).

## Kafka
- Production Kafka cluster: `ukafka-1lx9hnxqiple` with brokers 10.9.73.159:9092, 10.9.7.152:9092, 10.9.136.40:9092.
- Dev Kafka cluster (UCloud): 3 brokers 10.9.169.2:9092, 10.9.131.68:9092, 10.9.103.246:9092.
- Topic naming: `starlink.{game}.{env}.{schema}.{table}` (also `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public.feature_config_workflow_info`).
- Environment suffixes: `lgh` (test) and `prd` (production).
- CDC pipeline uses `pgpour` to stream PostgreSQL changes (e.g., from `bbc_publication`) to Kafka topics like `starlink.mjwd.alpha.public.solution_outbox`.
- Outbox event table: `_pm_idea_flow_outbox_event` (not old `pm.iceo.flow.outbox.event`).
- Environment variable `KAFKA_PLAN_STATE_SYNC_TOPICS` used for planning state sync.
- Topic `starlink.blockcrush.lgh.public._pm_idea_details_enriched` for enriched PM idea details in lgh blockcrush dev environment.

## Storage
- MinIO (server 10.254.3.107) and Aliyun OSS as destination; artifacts being migrated from MinIO to OSS.
- Two-bucket architecture per game (private and public).
- Buckets: `starlink-blockcrush-pm-artifacts`, `starlink-artifacts-prd`, `starlink-jdmj-pm-artifacts-public`.
- Credentials: `e.credentials/starlink/pm-artifacts-oss.txt`.
- RAM policy v2 covers four buckets.
- `/download` endpoint does not redirect to presigned URL (404 in prod, error in dev).
- PoC migration: only task-acceptance prefix migrated; art-submit prefix not copied.

## CI/CD
- Jenkins on `devops-jenkins.hs99.vip`; folder `starlink` contains jobs like `db-migrator`, `gql-build`, `frontend-build-with-cache`.
- Deployments via `deploy-multiapp` Ansible playbook or Helmfile.
- Helm charts: `starlink-bbc`, `starlink-rustyme`, `starlink-attachments`, `starlink-lowcodegql`, `starlink-atomkit`.
- Images built by Jenkins from `git.7k7k.com`, tagged `{BUILD_TYPE}-{APP_ID}-{branch}-{commit}`.
- Two container registries: `registry.hs99.vip` and `starfamily-registry-vpc.cn-beijing.cr.aliyuncs.com`.

## Access & Management
- Managed via JumpServer bastion `jump.hs99.vip`; hosts named `archteam-starlink-*`.
- Permission rule `archteam:starlink:starlink` grants 6 users access to 44 hosts with `@ALL` accounts and full actions.
- User is primary SRE and super admin (role 888).
- Local project path: `/Users/liguanghui/hs.projects/starlink`.
- Has kubeconfig files for Aliyun ACK starlink dev and prod clusters.

## Domains & Networking
- Public domain: `starlink.youxi123.com` (also `starlink.hs99.vip`), fronted by Aliyun ALBs (external and internal), then nginx, then Starflow.
- Inner VPC gateway: `starlink-inner.youxi123.com` resolves to 10.9.144.217.
- Read-only internal GraphQL endpoint: `https://starlink-ro-internal.youxi123.com/gql/` (resolves to 10.9.79.82).
- Dev environment served at wildcard domain `*.d.hs99.vip`, managed by Cloudflare DNS, CNAMEing to ALB `starlink-dev-d-hs99-vip-alb`.
- Dev series ALB: `starlink-dev-series-alb` with IngressClass `starlink-dev-series-alb` in namespace `starlink-dev-series`, wildcard TLS cert for `*.t.hs99.vip`.
- Compose URLs: `https://{env}-{game}.hs99.vip`; K8s URLs: `https://{game}-{env}.t.hs99.vip`.
- All live starlink domains use wildcard `*.youxi123.com` TLS certificate, valid 2026-01-23 to 2027-01-22.

## Data Model
- `feature_config` table stores feature_name, feature_desc_rich, pre_experiment_level, and idea_dimension (TEXT[]).
- `feature_tag_config` and `feature_tag_config_history` track feature tag config and edit history.
- `solution.tag` is a JSONB array linking to `feature_tag_config.id`; `feature_tag_config.feature_list` links to `feature_config.feature_id`.
- `feature_config` has unique constraint on `(platform, feature_id)`.
- Domain model: Solution → Way → Tag → Feature → Asset.

## Migration & Known Issues
- Alpha environment migrating from UCloud to Aliyun; production PostgreSQL migrated from UCloud 10.9.177.238 to Aliyun RDS.
- System of ~100 compose stacks being migrated to Kubernetes.
- Rust/GraphQL CLI models `solution_ai_mark_id` as `Option<String>` (TEXT), mismatching the database's INT4 column.
- The `db-migrator` `vars.yml` contains plaintext DB superuser passwords and TOTP secret, committed unencrypted in git (security issue).
- As of 2026-06-05, some UCloud hosts are dead (e.g., `starlink-prd-crushblast-1/2`, `starlink-prd-adx-01/02`).

memories.body:
# BlockCrush

## Overview
- BlockCrush is a game project at HungryStudio, part of the Starlink system, also known as `starlink-blockcrush` and `block-crush`.
- It is a Nebula series game and the current production game on Aliyun, replacing the retired crushblast.
- Serves as the reference architecture for new deployments and is a sub-project of Starlink, also a game under the BBC project.
- Integrated with the cehua AI platform and Starlink AI platform.
- Older project whose settings remain in the Block Bloom compose tree; its app configs served as templates for BlockBloom.
- The user works on it and holds role 888 super admin; 卫炜 (Wei Wei) is the creative reviewer.

## Environments
- Production host: `https://starlink-blockcrush.youxi123.com`
- LGH host: `https://lgh-blockcrush.ext.hs99.vip` (also has `.ext` subdomain on hs99.vip)
- Dev (lsx) environment: `https://lsx-blockcrush.hs99.vip` with Redis at `starlink-dev-internal.hs99.vip:31200` DB0
- Cat environment: gateway ingress host `bc-cat.d.hs99.vip`, cluster `ack-starlink-dev` (declared in `envs/blockcrush/cat/env-values.yaml`)
- Environments include: prod, alpha, yy, mx, cat, lby, dwb, lgh, yl, yy (dev), and prd (prod). Project family has 14 environments.
- Production servers: `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-app-1` (10.100.25.26) and `-2` (10.100.25.25), accessed via JumpServer.
- Internal ALB: `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-prod-internal`; External ALB: `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-prod-external`.

## Infrastructure
- **PostgreSQL**: Production RDS at `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-pg16.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com:5432` (PG 16.13), hosting `prd_blockcrush_client` and `prd_blockcrush_codekeeper`. Also `alpha_blockcrush_client`, `lgh_blockcrush_client`, `lsx_blockcrush_client`, `lby_blockcrush_client`.
- **Redis**: Production Aliyun Tair instance at `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-redis.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com:6379` (DB 0), instance `r-2zeo2vah2w71dtap4q` in cn-beijing.
- **Recommendation Redis**: Separate `REDIS_RECOMMEND_*` isolated from cache Redis; falls back to main cache Redis if `REDIS_RECOMMEND_HOST` unset. Must not be flushed.
- **Deployment**: Production at `/data/starlink-blockcrush-prod/` on app-1 and app-2. Docker Compose runs containers: vector, bbc, frontend, starflow, gql on each node.
- Credentials stored at `e.credentials/starlink/blockcrush.txt`.
- Uses `starfamily-registry-vpc.cn-beijing.cr.aliyuncs.com` for attachments.
- Production config maintained server-side at `config/bbc/env.prod` (bind-mounted); repo has no `bbc/envs/block_crush/.env.prod`.
- BBC scripts load env from `bbc/envs/{proj}/.env.{env}` via `create_app(env, proj)`, with optional `.env.{env}.local` overrides.

## Databases & Schema
- `prd_blockcrush_client` holds PM, authority, and work item tables; `prd_blockcrush_codekeeper` holds the avatar directory.
- `prd_blockcrush_codekeeper.public.avatar` is the people directory (originally 95 rows; `dingding_name` unique) mapping display names to avatar id and workcode.
- `fc_workflow_info.*_avatar_id` references `avatar.id` rather than workcode.
- Feature configs stored in `feature_config` and `fc_workflow_info` tables; `feature_config.workflow_info_id` links to `fc_workflow_info`.
- `fc_workflow_info` stores workflow rows with submitter/follower text[] name arrays and parallel `submitter_avatar_*`/`follower_avatar_*` arrays (name, id, workcode) kept position-aligned.
- Excel mapping: 提出人(可多选) → `fc_workflow_info.submitter`, 跟进人 → `fc_workflow_info.follower`.
- `feature_config` table has partial unique constraint on `(platform, feature_id)` where `is_delete=false` and `feature_id>0`.
- Feature configs managed via Excel `feature_name→feature_key` mappings, stored in `lgh_blockcrush_client` and `prd_blockcrush_client`; being migrated from LGH to PRD.
- `prd` and `dwb` PostgreSQL databases kept in schema sync via Atlas diffs.
- `alpha_blockcrush_client` contains `pm_*` module (pm_project, pm_work_item, etc.) that `prd_blockcrush_client` lacks.
- MX databases are dumps of production, so mx and prd contain identical data.
- Dev/MX database: `starlink-dev-all-in-one.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (has extra tables like `pm_agent`, `pm_flow_parallel_run`, `pm_work_item_review_round`).
- Production database settings: `wal_keep_size=2GB`, `max_wal_size=2GB`, `min_wal_size=512MB`.

## PM Module
- Tracks requirements and creative ideas.
- `pm_work_item.priority` maps: urgent=10, high=8, medium=5, low=2. Legacy enum values: low→3, medium→5, high→8, urgent→10. Prod BBC serves priority as integers 1–10.
- Business logic assumes exactly one PM project with id=1, but prod currently has `pm_project` only containing id=21.
- Orphaned rows under project_id=1: 59 `pm_flow_node`, 17 `pm_flow_instance`, 6 soft-deleted `pm_flow_definition`.
- Under project_id=21: 2 active flow definitions, 15 active flow nodes, 2 running flow instances (ids 18 and 19, belonging to test work items 【测试】Other类需求 id 3 and Gina测试1 id 7), 2 iterations, 8 work items.
- `pm_flow_node` has unique constraint `uq_pm_flow_node_project_key` on `(project_id, node_key)`.
- In prod, `pm_*` tables have seven FK constraints referencing `pm_project(id)`.
- Lby database restore (via Ansible) fails with rc=1 because `pm_flow_definition`, `pm_flow_node`, and `pm_flow_instance` FK constraints were not created during restore.

## CDC / Pipelines
- CDC pipeline (87142) consumed by pgpour from `prd_blockcrush_client`.
- pgpour runs on `archteam-starlink-pgpour-prd-all-in-one`.
- `bbc_publication` includes 5 tables: `_kafka_message_bi_solution`, `_pm_idea_flow_outbox_event`, `feature_config`, `feature_config_workflow_info`, `pm_work_item`.
- pgpour replicates `feature_config_workflow_info` and `_pm_idea_flow_outbox_event` to Kafka under `starlink.blockcrush.*` topic prefix, with alpha, LGH dev, and prod environments.
- Production Kafka environment with topic pattern `JDMJ/blockcrush`.
- BlockCrush lgh and JDMJ lgh publications differ: BlockCrush lgh has solution/solution_way, JDMJ lgh has `_kafka_message_bi_solution`.
- Prod pgpour has planner-AI integration via `feature_config_workflow_info` and `_pm_idea_flow_outbox_event` (BlockBlast prod lacks this).

## Feature Config & Docs
- Feature descriptions follow format `level·tag·name`; uses enum term 底板优化 for optimization labels.
- `feature_config` labels have `feature_name` and `feature_desc` fields; `feature_desc` uses three-part format.
- DingTalk doc links stored in PM requirements (`extra.creative_doc_link`) and FC creatives (`feature_config.url_doc`).
- Links can diverge: creative-to-requirement conversion copies a snapshot; no reverse sync from creative to requirement. Creative updates via Kafka don't propagate to bound requirement.

## Miscellaneous
- BBC application containers run with `/etc/timezone` set to Etc/UTC on prd and dwb; PostgreSQL sessions inherit Asia/Shanghai timezone.
- gql service misconfigured to run mahjong-wonders image tag `prod-mahjong-wonders-main-acd7aa54` (TODO comment in .env).
- Materialization script refuses to run with `--env prod`.
- Recommendation feature stores avatar-pick scores in Redis ZSETs keyed `recommend:{scene}:{scope}:{actor_id}`.
- BlockCrush runs starflow image `main-9794c425` and gets 404 on `/flow/metrics`.
- Production attachments service deployed at `starlink-blockcrush.youxi123.com/attachments/`; UI reads `meta_value → file.url` to download task acceptance videos.
- PM artifacts stored in MinIO and OSS buckets; migrated from MinIO to Aliyun OSS. OSS credentials manually written to `config/attachments/env` using shared RAM user `starlink-pm-artifacts-oss`.
- Uses BlockBlast's hfrog and shared MinIO bucket in production; has Aliyun ACR login configured.
- JDMJ and BlockCrush schema differ only on the `pm_project` table (3 columns).
- Tables include: `pm_work_item`, `fc_workflow_info`, `avatar`, `pm_agent`, `pm_agent_flow_draft`, `pm_agent_run`, `pm_flow_step_deliverable`, `pm_flow_parallel_run`, `pm_flow_parallel_branch`.

memories.body:
# AtomKit

## Overview
AtomKit is a Starlink-internal Python uvicorn service that proxies the Yunxiao (RDC) OpenAPI for work items and spaces. It is a cloud effect OpenAPI agent. It is not the company SSO service (SSO is at sso.youxi123.com). It uses the Yunxiao OpenAPI and a Redis instance for its DingTalk failure queue. It is stateless and configured only via an env file.

## Environments
- **Alpha**: atomkit-alpha.hs99.vip, deployed under /data/ on host 10.100.95.238.
- **Dev**: atomkit-dev.hs99.vip, exposed on port 9192 in K8s (dev-shared-services environment). Also runs on host archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one at /data/atomkit-dev-all-in-one, on port 19192.
- **Prod**: atomkit-internal.youxi123.com, with internal endpoint at the same domain. Also has a prod nginx config atomkit.youxi123.com.conf that terminates CORS, WebSocket, and 600s timeouts at the edge.

## Deployment Details
- **Source repo**: git@git.7k7k.com:starlink/atom-kit.git
- **Docker image**: registry.hs99.vip/starlink/atomkit, mirrored to Aliyun ACR starfamily-registry.cn-beijing.cr.aliyuncs.com/starlink/atomkit. Prod image tag: main-2043ecf8.
- **Prod deployment**: Runs on host 10.9.79.254 under /opt/atomkit-prod/. Also runs as atomkit-prod container on host starlink-umami-metabase-atomkit-prod. Also on starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1 and -2 (port 19192). New host 10.100.95.77 has config at /data/atomkit-prod/config/env.
- **Dev deployment**: In K8s dev-shared-services, uses ALB with HTTPS listener, cert-manager Certificate, and letsencrypt-cloudflare ClusterIssuer. Also runs on legacy starlink-dev-shared-services-alb.
- **Ports**: Dev service on port 9192 in K8s; prod VMs on port 19192; prod image runs uvicorn on port 9192 (likely container port).
- **Config**: Prod config mounted from /opt/atomkit-prod/config/env to /app/envs/.env. Stateless, configured only via env file.

## Configuration and Secrets
- Uses per-key SOPS-encrypted comments in secrets.enc.yaml.
- Reference uses plain path "/" with a Prefix option.

## Security and Access
- Production deploys restricted to Jenkins users liguanghui001232 and kongweidong001362.
- Not the company SSO service.

## Additional Notes
- AtomKit is a personal project of the user.
- It is a service running in containers on the starlink blockblast PRD app nodes.
- It is the legacy starlink dev shared services ALB (starlink-dev-shared-services-alb).

memories.abstract: BlockBlast is a casual game by HungryStudio, hosted on Starlink, part of the BBC project, with 14 dev environments, production on UCloud/Aliyun, PostgreSQL databases, and data pipelines.
memories.body:
# BlockBlast

BlockBlast is a casual game developed by HungryStudio, hosted on Starlink and part of the BBC project. It is one of four live games in the starlink repo and is a standalone Starlink game (not in the Nebula series). The user works on its data pipelines.

## Environments
- 14 named development environments: dev, kwd, yy, yl, cyx, hyx, lxy, lby, mx, dwb, lgh, lhh, lsx, wz.
- Production environment: starlink-blockblast-prod.
- LSX dev environment at https://lsx-blockblast.hs99.vip with Redis at starlink-dev-uc.hs99.vip:31000 DB0.
- LHH environment reachable at lhh-blockblast.hs99.vip.
- Dev host: archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one runs 14 Block Blast dev namespaces (cyx, dev, dwb, hyx, kwd, lby, lgh, lhh, lsx, lxy, mx, wz, yl, yy).
- Each namespace has /data/starlink-<namespace>-blockblast/config/bbc/env.dev, mounted to /app/envs/default/.env.dev in the container. Files are root-owned (-rw-r--r--) and require sudo to edit.

## Infrastructure
- Production app servers: old UCloud set starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1 (10.9.79.254) and app-2 (10.9.164.112); new Aliyun set archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3 (10.100.30.117-119).
- The starlink-prd-blockblast app pair (2 hosts) is hosted on UCloud with egress IPs 106.75.x.
- Source host for prod deployment: 10.9.79.254 (UCloud).
- Prod BBC logs shipped from 5 hosts: archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3, archteam-starlink-blockblast-prd-ro-1, and starlink-prd-blockblast-ro-1.
- Prod BBC RO hosts have OTEL exporter connection failures to localhost:4318/v1/metrics.
- BlockBlast prod .env identical across all three hosts: APP_ID=block-blast, HOST=starlink.youxi123.com, image tags, fixed service ports 20000-20011.
- Docker-compose uses images from registry.hs99.vip/starlink/bbc and sends OTEL metrics to host.docker.internal:24318.
- Migration from UCloud to Aliyun uses a UCloud jumpserver at 106.75.24.230 for SSH access.
- Read-only nodes (JumpServer): 4 nodes – archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro-1 (10.100.0.31), -ro-2 (10.100.0.56), -ro-3 (10.100.116.171), -ro-4 (10.100.0.37).
- RO tier services: Only bbc and gql; no starflow/hfrog/OTLP. Data path: /data/starlink-blockblast-prod.
- Application stack: Deployed at starlink-alpha.youxi123.com, 12 containers, reverse proxy openresty.
- pgpour: Config on archteam-starlink-pgpour-prd-all-in-one at /data/starlink-blockblast-pgpour-prod/. Reads PostgreSQL (db prd_blockblast_client, user starlink_user, publication bbc_publication) and publishes to Kafka topics prefixed starlink.blockblast.prd.
- CDC: No solution_history or solution table CDC; only solution-change channel is BI outbox topic _kafka_message_bi_solution with source_type=solution.
- Nginx access log: JSON format does not include $http_cookie.

## Databases
- Production PostgreSQL databases: hs_client_db (~14 GB) and hs_code_keeper_db (~9 MB).
- Migrating to Aliyun RDS (instance pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4, account caikuai-cn): host archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com, RO host archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com, port 5432, databases prd_blockblast_client and prd_blockblast_codekeeper.
- Also uses prd_blockblast_hfrog on blockblast-prod RDS.
- Client database has production connection ID PROD_BLOCKBLAST_CLIENT_DB.
- In all environments, public.solution.solution_ai_mark_id is integer (INT4), nullable, with FK to solution_ai_marks(id).
- solution_ai_marks table uses serial id; BBC flow writes integer IDs back into solution.solution_ai_mark_id.
- Production databases prd_blockblast_codekeeper.avatar (username and DingTalk staffId) and prd_blockblast_client.uums.yunxiao_member_bind (DingTalk binding fallback) are used to look up employee DingTalk IDs.
- prd_blockblast_client is a separate game database (~120 tables), not part of the Nebula 5-DB set. Hosted at archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com (read-only) and archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com (for pgpour).
- Dev database: lhh_blockblast_client has a bbc_publication containing solution_way but not solution.

## Services
- hfrog artifact service shared with BlockCrush; BlockBlast has its own hfrog database (prd_blockblast_hfrog) on blockblast-prod RDS.
- Production backend is the BBC service.
- fakeuser service exposes /fakeuser/users since image main-b2394645 (2.0); older image main-6773fc85 lacks it. Used for user auth in many environments (dwb, lby, dev, kwd, lgh, lhh, lxy, cyx, mx, hyx).
- external_system configuration includes services: admarket, n8n, hfrog, user, bbc, automated_testing, mainstream_automated_testing, publish_platform_gp, publish_platform_ios.

## Pipelines
- CDC pipeline (18977) consumed by pgpour.
- PRD BI solution uses Outbox → message table → pgpour → Kafka pipeline.
- pgpour prod pipeline uses image tag main-2ce47744.

## Access & Security
- /api is open (no key required); /gql/ restricted to key-auth + ACL with consumers liguanghui, starorigin, bi, etc.
- The pgpour env file contains the PostgreSQL password; treat as sensitive and never commit to git.

## Issues
- Jenkins jobs (alpha, lby, lxy) write ~1.3G DB dumps to /tmp on uc-devops-jenkins and never clean them up, causing recurring disk pressure.

## Miscellaneous
- BlockBlast is part of the user's infrastructure scope at HungryStudio.
- BlockBlast is a product whose PRD infrastructure runs on starlink hosts (app, ro, n8n, alpha nodes).
- BlockBlast has dedicated read-only endpoints on Aliyun.
- BlockBlast is a product with two production PostgreSQL databases: hs_client_db and hs_code_keeper_db.
- BlockBlast has a workflow construction team.

# JumpServer

- REST API and KoKo SSH gateway on port 2222.

## Accounts & Permissions

## Administration

memories.abstract: Starlink is HungryStudio's game configuration/A-B testing platform, supporting multiple games across dev/alpha/prod, with Docker Compose and Kubernetes, PostgreSQL RDS, Kafka CDC, and a PM workflow.
memories.body:
# Starlink

Starlink (星链) is a game configuration, A/B testing, and project management platform at HungryStudio. It supports games including BlockBlast, BlockCrush, BlockMJ (BlockMahjong), MJWD, JDMJ, BlockBloom, Merge, TapTile, and the Nebula series. The user is the primary SRE and super admin (role 888).

## Components
- **BBC**: Python backend (Flask)
- **Frontend (SolutionHub)**: PM UI
- **wirerope-gql**: Rust GraphQL read API
- **Ding**: OpenResty gateway
- **starflow**, **vector**, **hfrog**, **pgpour**: additional services
- **fakeuser**: LGH only
- **Forwarder**: outbox events component
- **starlai**, **rustyme**, **staroriginweb**, **docs**, **nginx**, **asyncmon**: other services
- Helm charts: `starlink-bbc`, `starlink-rustyme`, `starlink-attachments`, `starlink-lowcodegql`, `starlink-atomkit`

## Environments
- **Production**: `starlink.youxi123.com` (also `starlink.hs99.vip`), hosted on Aliyun ALBs and ECS hosts (e.g., `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3` at 10.100.30.117/118/119, `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-1/2`, `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-1/2`).
- **Alpha**: `starlink-alpha.youxi123.com` via Aliyun SLB 101.201.239.158 to `archteam-starlink-alpha` (10.100.95.238).
- **Dev**: All-in-one host `archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one` (IPs 10.100.48.251 and 10.100.64.132), runs ~300–383 containers. Dev domains: `*.d.hs99.vip` (K8s) and `{env}-{game}.hs99.vip` (Compose).
- 6 game variants, 14 dev environments (dev, kwd, yy, yl, cyx, hyx, lxy, lby, mx, dwb, lgh, lhh, lsx, wz), each with ~14 services.
- Deployment roots: `/data/starlink-{ns}-{game}/` (Compose) and K8s namespaces `starlink-{game}-{env}`.

## Databases
- **Dev RDS**: `starlink-dev-all-in-one.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (PostgreSQL 16), hosts all dev environment databases (e.g., `dwb_blockcrush_client`, `lgh_blockmj_client`).
- **Alpha RDS**: `archteam-starlink-alpha-pg.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`.
- **Production RDS**: `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (instance `pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4`), databases `hs_client_db` and `hs_code_keeper_db`. Also `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-pg16.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` for BlockCrush.
- **Shared-services RDS**: `archteam-starlink-prd-shared-services.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, database `fework_prd_db` (tables: `app_group`, `app_info`, `app_login`, `release`, `work`).
- Each cell has two databases: `{env}_{game}_client` and `{env}_{game}_codekeeper`. Permissions stored in `avatar.role` JSONB array in codekeeper.
- Old UCloud PostgreSQL at `10.9.177.238:5432` (legacy).

## Kafka
- Topic naming: `starlink.{game}.{env}.{schema}.{table}` and `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public.feature_config_workflow_info`.
- Production brokers: `10.9.73.159:9092`, `10.9.7.152:9092`, `10.9.136.40:9092`. Dev brokers: `10.9.169.2:9092`, `10.9.131.68:9092`, `10.9.103.246:9092`.
- CDC via `pgpour` streams PostgreSQL changes to Kafka (e.g., `starlink.mjwd.alpha.public.solution_outbox`).
- Outbox topic pattern: `biz.starlink.jdmj.{env}.public._pm_idea_flow_outbox_event`.

## Networking
- Public gateway: `starlink.youxi123.com` → ALB → nginx → Starflow. Internal: `starlink-inner.youxi123.com`, `starlink-ro-internal.youxi123.com`.
- Dev wildcard `*.d.hs99.vip` via ALB `starlink-dev-d-hs99-vip-alb`; K8s wildcard `*.t.hs99.vip` via `starlink-dev-series-alb`.
- TLS via cert-manager; wildcard certs for `*.youxi123.com` and `*.hs99.vip`.
- SLBs: inner `10.100.94.249`, public `112.126.27.236`.

## Deployment & CI/CD
- Docker Compose on VMs (~95%) and growing Kubernetes/Helmfile on ACK clusters `ack-starlink-dev` and `ack-starlink-prod`.
- Jenkins at `devops-jenkins.hs99.vip` with jobs for bbc, gql, frontend, attachments, etc. Deploy via `deploy-multiapp` Ansible playbook.

memories.abstract: Starlink is HungryStudio's internal game configuration/A-B testing platform (星链) with ~6 games, 14 environments, ~14 services each, deployed via Docker Compose and Kubernetes on Aliyun/UCloud, using PostgreSQL, Kafka, and pgpour CDC.
memories.body:
# Starlink (星链)

Starlink is a major internal game configuration / A/B testing platform at HungryStudio, owned by 李广慧 (arch-starlink, 产品研发中心 architecture team). The user is primary SRE, system admin, and DevOps contact. It supports games like BlockBlast, BlockCrush, MJWD, SandCrush, BlockMahjong, Merge, TapTile, etc., and handles creative idea review, feature management, dev pipelines, and multi-environment deployment.

## Infrastructure

- Runs on Alibaba Cloud ACK managed Kubernetes clusters: `ack-starlink-dev` and `ack-starlink-prod`, with Jenkins credentials `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-dev` and `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-prod`.
- Also uses UCloud (current) and Aliyun (some components). UCloud inventory: ~70 active resources — 18 ECS (92 vCPU / 216 GB RAM), 4 RDS PostgreSQL, 2 Kafka, 2 Redis, ~3.4 TB ESSD, 20 EIP, 3 ALB. Monthly spend ~¥12.9K–13.2K.
- Dev all-in-one host: `archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one` at 10.100.48.251 (also 10.100.64.132, alias `starlink-dev-internal.hs99.vip`), runs ~300–383 containers for many team members; images pulled from `registry.hs99.vip/starlink`.
- Production ECS hosts (cn-beijing): `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-1` (10.100.116.202), `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-2` (10.100.143.39), `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-1` (10.100.116.201), `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-2` (10.100.143.38) — Rocky Linux 10.2, Docker CE 29.7.2, Docker Compose v5.4.0, network `starlink_network`, data dirs `/data/starlink-{merge,taptile}-prod`.
- BlockBlast app hosts: `archteam-starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1` (10.100.30.117), `app-2` (10.100.30.118), `app-3` (10.100.30.119).
- Alpha host: `archteam-starlink-alpha` (10.100.95.238), serving `https://starlink-alpha.youxi123.com` via Aliyun SLB 101.201.239.158.
- Production server: `starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1` (10.9.79.254).
- JumpServer bastion at `jump.hs99.vip`; 43 hosts and 1 database with 'starlink' in names.
- Docker registry: `registry.hs99.vip` (images under `registry.hs99.vip/starlink/*`) and `starfamily-registry-vpc.cn-beijing.cr.aliyuncs.com`.
- Cost group in Aliyun `caikuai-cn` account; two RDS PostgreSQL instances tagged to Starlink cost group.

## Environments

- 6 game variants, 14 dev environments, each with ~14 services. Games: BlockCrush, BlockBlast, MJWD, BlockMahjong, SandCrush, Merge, TapTile, etc.
- 14 blockblast environments: dev, kwd, yy, yl, cyx, hyx, lxy, lby, mx, dwb, lgh, lhh, lsx, wz.
- Each game has multiple test environments, one alpha, one production (multi-node).
- Environments: dev, alpha, prod across Aliyun and UCloud.
- Dev environment served at wildcard domain `*.d.hs99.vip` (K8s) and `*.hs99.vip` (Compose).
- Production website: `starlink.youxi123.com` (also `starlink.hs99.vip`).
- Public gateway: `starlink.youxi123.com` resolves to 106.75.64.81 (UCloud nginx/1.20.1). Inner VPC gateway: `starlink-inner.youxi123.com` resolves to 10.9.144.217.
- All live domains use wildcard `*.youxi123.com` TLS certificate valid 2026-01-23 to 2027-01-22.

## Services & Components

- Core services: `bbc` (Python backend), `gql` (Rust GraphQL read API), `frontend` (SolutionHub), `ding` (OpenResty gateway), `starflow`, `hfrog`, `pgpour` (CDC), `vector`, `redis`, `starlai`, `fakeuser`, `rustyme`, `staroriginweb`, `openresty`, `nginx`, `asyncmon`, `feworkgql`, `attachments`.
- Frontend apps: `block-blast`, `block-mahjong`, `mahjong-wonders`, `block-crush`.
- CLI client: `starlink-cli` (Rust/GraphQL).
- BFF service listens on port 3100 with `/health` endpoint.
- Helm charts: `starlink-bbc`, `starlink-rustyme`, `starlink-attachments`, `starlink-lowcodegql`, `starlink-atomkit`.
- Container naming: `starlink-<user>-<game>-<service>-1` (users: lhh, dwb, lgh, lby, wz, yl, yy, mx, lxy, lsx, kwd, hyx, cyx, dev; games: blockblast, blockcrush, blockmj, mjwd).

## Databases

- Each Starlink cell has two PostgreSQL databases: `{env}_{game}_client` and `{env}_{game}_codekeeper`, hosted on the `starlink-dev-all-in-one` RDS instance (`starlink-dev-all-in-one.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, VPC IP 10.100.48.255, PostgreSQL 16.13).
- Dev all-in-one RDS hosts databases like `lgh_blockmj_client`, `solutionhub_dev`, `yy_blockblast_client`, `kwd_blockblast_client`, `dwb_blockcrush_client`, `dwb_mjwd_client`, `mx_blockcrush_client`, `mx_blockcrush_codekeeper`, etc.
- Alpha PostgreSQL RDS: `archteam-starlink-alpha-pg.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (port 5432), with replication slots for alpha_blockblast_client, alpha_blockcrush_client, alpha_mjwd_client.
- BlockBlast prod RDS: `pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4` (VPC IP 10.100.94.245:5432, DNS alias `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`; external endpoint `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ext.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com:5432`). Databases: `hs_code_keeper_db`, `hs_client_db`. Superuser `postgres` (password `YSYwtoeUwsQjLIvq1`), app user `starlink_user` (password `l8DrBC5GdTa7DT`). Read-replicas: `pgr-2ze00ogh570nd336` (alias `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`) and `pgr-2zee76956a0bqp6f`.
- BlockCrush production RDS: `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-pg16.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, database `prd_blockcrush_client`.
- Starlink merge RDS instance (`pgm-2zehh591176h9svz`) hosts `prd_merge_client` and `prd_merge_codekeeper`.
- Old UCloud PostgreSQL at 10.9.177.238:5432 still in use as of 2026-06-25; hosts `hs_client_db`, `hs_code_keeper_db`, `n8n_alpha_db`, `hs_frog`, `n8n_db`, `starl_ai_db`, `hs_staff_db`. Only `hs_client_db` and `hs_code_keeper_db` migrated to new RDS.
- Shared-services RDS: `archteam-starlink-prd-shared-services.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, database `fework_prd_db` (tables: app_group, app_info, app_login, release, work).
- Database naming on shared-services: `starlink_<slug>_client` and `starlink_<slug>_codekeeper`; `prd_*` reserved for dedicated per-game RDS.
- PostgreSQL role `starlink_user` owns taptile and merge databases.
- Credentials stored in `e.credentials/starlink/shared.txt`, `e.credentials/starlink/blockblast.txt`, `e.credentials/starlink/merge.txt`.

## Kafka

- Kafka clusters: UCloud brokers 10.9.169.2:9092, 10.9.131.68:9092, 10.9.103.246:9092; production brokers 10.9.73.159:9092, 10.9.7.152:9092, 10.9.136.40:9092.
- Topic naming convention: `starlink.{game}.{env}.{schema}.{table}` (e.g., `starlink.blockcrush.lgh.public._pm_idea_details_enriched`).
- Feature config workflow topic: `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public.feature_config_workflow_info`.
- Outbox topic pattern: `biz.starlink.jdmj.{env}.public._pm_idea_flow_outbox_event`.
- Environment variable `KAFKA_STARLINK_UPDATE_DATA_TOPIC` with prefix `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public`; `KAFKA_PLAN_STATE_SYNC_TOPICS` for outbox.
- CDC pipeline uses pgpour to stream PostgreSQL changes to Kafka topics like `starlink.mjwd.alpha.public.solution_outbox`.
- Vector service consumes Kafka topic `cehua-ai-platform.creative-ideas` and writes to Postgres.

## Deployment & CI/CD

- Two deployment paradigms: ~95% Docker Compose on VMs (`/data/starlink-{ns}-{game}/`) and growing K8s/Helmfile path on `ack-starlink-dev` backed by `starlink-deployments-*` Git repos.
- Jenkins folder `starlink` on `devops-jenkins.hs99.vip` contains jobs for frontend, bbc, gql, db-migrator, etc.
- Docker images built by Jenkins from `git.7k7k.com` sources, tagged as `{BUILD_TYPE}-{APP_ID}-{branch}-{commit}`.
- Deployments via `deploy-multiapp` Ansible playbook or helmfile.
- Config repo `starlink-deployments-dev`: `services/attachments/config` contains `app.yaml` and `secrets.enc.yaml` (SOPS-encrypted).
- Onboarding a new game is a manual runbook involving schema seed, target_envs.yml, Jenkins choices, starlink-envs, compose dirs, Kafka topics, DNS/SSO, and Atlas diff.

## Data Flow & Pipelines

- Application data flow: Browser → Ding → {BBC, GQL, Frontend, Starflow} → PostgreSQL → pgpour → Kafka → Vector → PostgreSQL, with Airflow → Starmap table → GQL.
- Postgres → Airflow → Starmap pipeline; production Airflow instance: `starlink-airflow-prd`.
- API endpoints: `POST /flow/v1/yunxiao/links/tag/async-update`, `https://starlink.youxi123.com/api/fc/ai_so/kafka/update_status`.
- GraphQL prod endpoint: `https://starlink.youxi123.com/gql/` (requires `X-Starlink-ApiKey` header).

## Feature Model & Other

- Domain model: Solution → Way → Tag → Feature → Asset.
- A single `feature_key` can have many parameter variants (normal design).
- Creative ideas (创意) are proposed and reviewed before becoming shipped features.
- Permissions stored in `avatar.role` JSONB array in each game's codekeeper database.
- SSO app id is loaded from GraphQL `appLogin` (fework DB) by request host; prod SSO apps typically have `access_everyone: true`.
- Sentry deployment: `starlink-sentry`.
- MinIO registry: `uc-starlink-hfrog-minio-registry`.
- Local project at `/Users/liguanghui/hs.projects/starlink`.
- User has a starlink deployment environment named `starlink-deployments-dev`.

memories.abstract: BlockBlast is a casual game by HungryStudio, part of Starlink/BBC, with production on UCloud/Aliyun, multiple dev environments, PostgreSQL databases, CDC via pgpour, and infrastructure details.
memories.body:
# BlockBlast

BlockBlast is a casual game developed by HungryStudio, part of the Starlink platform and the BBC project. It is one of four live games in the starlink repo and is a standalone game (not in the Nebula series). The user works on this game as part of their infrastructure scope at HungryStudio.

## Hosting & Infrastructure

- **Production app servers**:
  - Old UCloud set: `starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1` (10.9.79.254) and `app-2` (10.9.164.112), accessed via the `gg` profile.
  - New Aliyun set: `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3` (10.100.30.117/118/119).
- **RO hosts**: 4 read-only nodes in JumpServer: `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro-1` (10.100.0.31), `ro-2` (10.100.0.56), `ro-3` (10.100.116.171), `ro-4` (10.100.0.37). Logs are shipped from 5 hosts total (including app servers).
- **Deployment**: Docker-compose uses images from `registry.hs99.vip/starlink/bbc`, sends OTEL metrics to `host.docker.internal:24318`. Prod `.env` is identical across hosts with `APP_ID=block-blast`, `HOST=starlink.youxi123.com`, and fixed service ports 20000-20011.
- **Migration**: Production is being migrated from UCloud to Aliyun RDS. The Starflow service is part of this migration. A UCloud jumpserver at 106.75.24.230 is used for SSH access.
- **Application stack** deployed at `starlink-alpha.youxi123.com`, 12 containers, reverse proxy: openresty. Nginx JSON access log format does **not** include `$http_cookie`.

## Environments

BlockBlast has 14 named development environments: `dev`, `kwd`, `yy`, `yl`, `cyx`, `hyx`, `lxy`, `lby`, `mx`, `dwb`, `lgh`, `lhh`, `lsx`, `wz`. These are part of the starlink-alpha stack and use `fakeuser` for user auth in most environments.

- Host `archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one` runs 14 Block Blast dev namespaces: `cyx, dev, dwb, hyx, kwd, lby, lgh, lhh, lsx, lxy, mx, wz, yl, yy`.
- Each dev stack has a BBC env file at `/data/starlink-<namespace>-blockblast/config/bbc/env.dev`, mounted to `/app/envs/default/.env.dev` in the container. These env files are root-owned (`-rw-r--r--`) and require sudo to edit.

## Databases

- **Production PostgreSQL databases** (on UCloud): `hs_client_db` (~14 GB) and `hs_code_keeper_db` (~9 MB).
- **Aliyun RDS migration**: Instance `pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4`, account `caikuai-cn`, host `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, RO host `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, port 5432, databases `prd_blockblast_client` and `prd_blockblast_codekeeper`.
- **Additional databases**: `prd_blockblast_hfrog` on blockblast-prod RDS.
- **Schema note**: In all client databases (PRD, alpha, dev clones), `public.solution.solution_ai_mark_id` is integer (INT4), nullable, with FK to `solution_ai_marks(id)`. The `solution_ai_marks` table uses a serial id; BBC flow writes integer IDs back.
- **DingTalk lookups**: `prd_blockblast_codekeeper.avatar` (username and staffId) and `prd_blockblast_client.uums.yunxiao_member_bind` are used to find employee DingTalk IDs.
- **Dev DB**: `lhh_blockblast_client` has `bbc_publication` containing `solution_way` but not `solution`.

## Services & Configuration

- **hfrog**: BlockBlast provides the hfrog artifact service shared with BlockCrush; it has its own database `prd_blockblast_hfrog`.
- **BBC backend**: Production backend is the BBC service.
- **fakeuser**: Exposes `/fakeuser/users` since image `main-b2394645` (2.0); older image `main-6773fc85` lacks it.
- **API access**: `/api` is open (no key required); `/gql/` is restricted to key-auth + ACL with consumers `liguanghui`, `starorigin`, `bi`, etc.
- **External systems**: Services include `admarket`, `n8n`, `hfrog`, `user`, `bbc`, `automated_testing`, `mainstream_automated_testing`, `publish_platform_gp`, `publish_platform_ios`.
- **Jenkins**: Jobs (alpha, lby, lxy) write ~1.3G DB dumps to `/tmp` on `uc-devops-jenkins` and never clean up, causing disk pressure.
- **CDC/BI**: Production CDC pipeline (18977) consumed by pgpour; PRD BI uses Outbox → message table → pgpour → Kafka pipeline.

### pgpour (Production CDC)
- Config deployed on `archteam-starlink-pgpour-prd-all-in-one` at `/data/starlink-blockblast-pgpour-prod/`.
- Reads PostgreSQL `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (db `prd_blockblast_client`, user `starlink_user`, publication `bbc_publication`), publishes to Kafka topics prefixed `starlink.blockblast.prd`.
- Env file contains PostgreSQL password — treat as sensitive, never commit to git.
- No `solution_history` or `solution` table CDC; only solution-change channel is BI outbox topic `_kafka_message_bi_solution` with `source_type=solution`.

### Dev CDC
- Dev CDC topics (3 partitions, RF=2): `starlink.blockblast.dev.public.solution`, `starlink.blockblast.dev.public.solution_way`, `starlink.blockblast.dev.public.st_workflow`, `starlink.blockblast.dev.rustyme.public.feature_conflict_way`.
- Dev CDC uses database `dev_blockblast_client` on RDS `starlink-dev-all-in-one.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, via publication `bbc_publication` and pgpour.
- Dev CDC has `with_init: false` — no full snapshots, only table changes; messages are Debezium-style JSON with `after`/`op` fields.

## Patterns & Team
- `blockblast` is an existing Kong S2S gateway service used as a pattern for new S2S services.
- RO nodes (ro-1, ro-4) serve as a pattern for gateway deployments.
- BlockBlast has a workflow construction team.

## Current Status

As of 2026-05-27, the project family is still active on the old database, with migration to Aliyun RDS in progress.

memories.body:
# Starlink (星链)

Starlink is a game configuration and A/B testing platform at HungryStudio, used for creative idea review, feature management, development pipelines, and multi-environment deployment. It supports games including BlockBlast, BlockCrush, JDMJ (Jade Mahjong), MJWD, Mahjong Wonders, Guofeng Mahjong, BlockMJ, SandCrush, Merge, Tap-tile, Gogoblast, and others. The platform spans ~6 game variants, ~14 dev environments, and ~14 services per environment, running ~300–383 containers on the dev host.

## Infrastructure

- **Cloud providers**: Aliyun (primary) and UCloud (legacy).
- **Kubernetes**: Alibaba Cloud ACK clusters `ack-starlink-dev` and `ack-starlink-prod`, controlled via Jenkins credentials `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-dev` and `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-prod`.
- **Container registries**: `registry.hs99.vip` and `starfamily-registry-vpc.cn-beijing.cr.aliyuncs.com`.
- **Dev hosts**:
  - `archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one` at `10.100.48.251` (runs ~383 containers, images from `registry.hs99.vip/starlink`).
  - `starlink-dev-internal.hs99.vip` → `10.100.64.132` (alias `aa.t.hs99.vip`), accessed as `osadmin` with key `~/hungrystudio/c.ssh-keys/jumpserver-osadmin`.
- **Production hosts**:
  - BlockBlast: `archteam-starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1/2/3` at `10.100.30.117/118/119` (Aliyun).
  - Merge: `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-1` (10.100.116.202), `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-2` (10.100.143.39).
  - Tap-tile: `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-1` (10.100.116.201), `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-2` (10.100.143.38).
  - JDMJ: `archteam-starlink-jdmj-prod-1` and `archteam-starlink-jdmj-prod-2`.
  - Gogoblast: `archteam-starlink-gogoblast-app-1`.
  - Legacy UCloud: `starlink-prd-blockblast-app-1` at `10.9.79.254` (still runs `starlink.youxi123.com`).
- **Alpha**: `https://starlink-alpha.youxi123.com` via Aliyun SLB `101.201.239.158` → host `archteam-starlink-alpha` at `10.100.95.238`.
- **JumpServer**: `jump.hs99.vip`; 43 hosts and 1 database with 'starlink' in names. Permission rule `archteam:starlink:starlink` grants 6 users access to 44 hosts.
- **Networking**: Public gateway `starlink.youxi123.com` (resolves to `106.75.64.81` on UCloud), inner VPC gateway `starlink-inner.youxi123.com` (10.9.144.217). Wildcard TLS certificate `*.youxi123.com` valid 2026-01-23 to 2027-01-22.

## Services & Components

- **BBC**: Python backend (also submodule `block_crush`).
- **wirerope-gql**: Rust GraphQL read API.
- **Ding**: OpenResty gateway (nginx).
- **starflow**: Service for workflow events.
- **vector**: Consumes Kafka and writes to PostgreSQL.
- **hfrog**: Service for artifact presigning and downloads.
- **pgpour**: CDC replication from PostgreSQL to Kafka.
- **fakeuser**: LGH only.
- **forwarder**: For outbox events.
- **Other services**: attachments, frontend, redis, starlai, asyncmon, rustyme, staroriginweb, lowcodegql, atomkit.
- **Frontend apps**: block-blast, block-mahjong, mahjong-wonders, block-crush.
- **CLI**: `starlink-cli` for read-only gateways.

## Databases

- **Dev RDS**: `starlink-dev-all-in-one.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (instance `pgm-2zem02dsw7d3yvu8`), PostgreSQL 16.13, user `solutionhub_dev`. Hosts per-user databases like `lgh_blockmj_client`, `dwb_blockcrush_client`, `yy_blockblast_client`, `kwd_blockblast_client`, `pm1_dev_client`, etc.
- **Alpha RDS**: `archteam-starlink-alpha-pg.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com:5432` (instance `pgm-2zehh591176h9svz`? Actually that's merge; alpha is separate).
- **Prod RDS instances**:
  - BlockBlast: `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (instance `pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4`, VPC IP 10.100.94.245), databases `hs_client_db` and `hs_code_keeper_db`. Read replica `pgr-2ze00ogh570nd336` (alias `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`).
  - BlockCrush: `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-pg16.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`, database `prd_blockcrush_client`.
  - Merge: `pgm-2zehh591176h9svz` hosts `prd_merge_client` and `prd_merge_codekeeper`.
  - Gogoblast: `archteam-starlink-gogoblast-prd.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com:5432` (instance `pgm-2zevdzevrmf9l651`).
  - Shared services: `archteam-starlink-prd-shared-services.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` with database `fework_prd_db` (tables `app_group`, `app_info`, `app_login`, `release`, `work`).
- **Naming convention**: Each game/environment has `{env}_{game}_client` and `{env}_{game}_codekeeper` databases. On shared-services, stacks use `starlink_<slug>_client` and `starlink_<slug>_codekeeper`.
- **Roles**: Superuser `postgres` (password YSYwtoeUwsQjLIvq1), app user `starlink_user` (password l8DrBC5GdTa7DT). Old UCloud roles not present on new RDS.
- **Legacy UCloud PostgreSQL**: `10.9.177.238:5432` hosts `hs_client_db`, `hs_code_keeper_db`, `n8n_alpha_db`, `hs_frog`, `n8n_db`, `starl_ai_db`, `hs_staff_db`; only `hs_client_db` and `hs_code_keeper_db` migrated to new RDS.

## Kafka & CDC

- **Brokers**: Production cluster `ukafka-1lx9hnxqiple` with brokers `10.9.73.159:9092`, `10.9.7.152:9092`, `10.9.136.40:9092`. Dev cluster on UCloud: `10.9.169.2:9092`, `10.9.131.68:9092`, `10.9.103.246:9092` (plaintext, no SASL).
- **Topic naming**: `starlink.{game}.{env}.{schema}.{table}` (e.g., `starlink.blockcrush.lgh.public._pm_idea_details_enriched`).
- **CDC pipeline**: pgpour streams PostgreSQL changes (e.g., from publications like `bbc_publication`) to Kafka topics, then vector consumes and writes to PostgreSQL.
- **Outbox topics**: `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public._pm_idea_flow_outbox_event` (table `_pm_idea_flow_outbox_event`).
- **Environment variable**: `KAFKA_STARLINK_UPDATE_DATA_TOPIC` uses prefix `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public`; `KAFKA_PLAN_STATE_SYNC_TOPICS` for outbox.
- **Blockblast dev CDC**: streams from `dev_blockblast_client` to topics prefixed `starlink.blockblast.dev`.

## Storage

- **MinIO**: Server `10.254.3.107` (legacy).
- **Aliyun OSS**: Artifacts being migrated from MinIO to OSS. Two-bucket architecture per game (private and public). Buckets include `starlink-blockcrush-pm-artifacts`, `starlink-jdmj-pm-artifacts-public`, `starlink-artifacts-prd`.
- **Credentials**: `e.credentials/starlink/pm-artifacts-oss.txt`; RAM policy v2 covers four buckets.
- **Artifact URLs**: Stored in `pm_work_item_meta` table. Known issue: `/download` endpoint does not redirect to presigned URL (404 in prod, error in dev).
- **Attachment paths**: Relative URLs like `/attachments/{key}/{filename}`.

## Deployment & CI/CD

- **Jenkins**: `devops-jenkins.hs99.vip` with folder `starlink` containing jobs for frontend, bbc, gql, db-migrator, etc. Example job: `starlink/db-migrator-client-only`.
- **Deployment methods**: Docker Compose on VMs (`/data/starlink-{ns}-{game}/`) and Helmfile/K8s on ACK. ~95% Compose, growing K8s path.
- **Helm charts**: `starlink-bbc`, `starlink-rustyme`, `starlink-attachments`, `starlink-lowcodegql`, `starlink-atomkit`.
- **Config**: Env files use `*_IMAGE_TAG` convention; `GQL_IMAGE_TAG` stored in `/data/starlink-<game>-prod/.env`.
- **Onboarding new game**: Manual runbook involving schema seed, `target_envs.yml`, Jenkins choices, `starlink-envs`, compose dirs, Kafka topics, DNS/SSO, and Atlas diff.

## Authentication & SSO

- User identity stored in codekeeper's `avatar` table and `avatar_role` table.
- SSO app id not in BBC env.prod; frontend loads it from GraphQL `appLogin` (fework DB) by request host.
- Prod SSO apps typically created with `access_everyone: true`.
- Starlink SSO Client ID `1181083881` stored in `fework_prod` database.

## URLs & Routing

- **Production**: `starlink.youxi123.com` (public), `starlink-inner.youxi123.com` (VPC), `starlink.hs99.vip` (static frontend + BBC).
- **Dev**: `*.d.hs99.vip` (wildcard, managed by Cloudflare DNS, CNAME to ALB `starlink-dev-d-hs99-vip-alb`).
- **K8s**: `https://{game}-{env}.t.hs99.vip`.
- **Compose**: `https://{env}-{game}.hs99.vip`.
- **GraphQL endpoints**: `https://starlink.youxi123.com/gql/` (requires `X-Starlink-ApiKey` header), read-only internal `https://starlink-ro-internal.youxi123.com/gql/` (resolves to `10.9.79.82`).
- **API examples**: `POST /flow/v1/yunxiao/links/tag/async-update`, `POST /api/fc/ab_3/kafka/update_status`.

## Other Details

- **Cost**: Starlink is a cost group in Aliyun `caikuai-cn` account. Monthly cost ~¥12.9K–13.2K.
- **Security issue**: `db-migrator vars.yml` contains plaintext DB superuser passwords and TOTP secret, committed unencrypted in git.
- **Team**: User is primary SRE and super admin (role 888). Project `arch-starlink` in 产品研发中心 architecture team, owned by 李广慧.
- **Local project**: `/Users/liguanghui/hs.projects/starlink`.
- **Known issues**: `starlink-internal.youxi123.com` does not exist (NXDOMAIN); `-inner` domain variants don't exist for block-mahjong, mahjong-wonders, or blockcrush stacks.
- **Feature model**: A single `feature_key` can have many parameter variants (normal design). `feature_tag_config.online_status` reflects current state but history snapshots don't record changes.
- **Data pipeline**: Postgres → pgpour → Kafka → vector → Postgres, with Airflow → Starmap table → GQL.

memories.body:
# Starlink (星链)

Starlink is a game configuration and A/B testing platform at HungryStudio, used for creative workflow, feature management, and multi-environment deployment. It hosts multiple games (BlockCrush, BlockBlast, JDMJ, MJWD, BlockMahjong, Merge, TapTile, SandCrush, etc.) across 14+ environments (dev, alpha, prod, and per-developer environments). The user is the primary SRE and super admin (role 888).

## Infrastructure

- Runs on Alibaba Cloud ACK managed Kubernetes clusters: `ack-starlink-dev` and `ack-starlink-prod`, with Jenkins credentials `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-dev` and `kubeconfig-ack-starlink-prod`.
- Dual-paradigm deployment: ~95% Docker Compose on VMs (under `/data/starlink-{ns}-{game}/`) and growing K8s/Helmfile path on `ack-starlink-dev`.
- Dev all-in-one host: `archteam-starlink-dev-all-in-one` (10.100.64.132, also `starlink-dev-internal.hs99.vip`, `aa.t.hs99.vip`), runs ~300–383 containers.
- Production hosts: `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3` (10.100.30.117/118/119), `archteam-starlink-merge-prod-1/2` (10.100.116.202, 10.100.143.39), `archteam-starlink-taptile-prod-1/2` (10.100.116.201, 10.100.143.38), `archteam-starlink-hs99-vip-prd` (10.100.116.152), `archteam-starlink-jdmj-prod-1/2`, `archteam-starlink-gogoblast-app-1`.
- Alpha environment: `https://starlink-alpha.youxi123.com` via Aliyun SLB 101.201.239.158 to host `archteam-starlink-alpha` (10.100.95.238).
- Production hosts use Docker network `starlink_network` and directories like `/data/starlink-{merge,taptile}-prod`.
- Container registries: `registry.hs99.vip` and `starfamily-registry-vpc.cn-beijing.cr.aliyuncs.com`.
- Production BlockBlast app on Aliyun hosts `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-app-1/2/3` (10.100.30.117/118/119).
- Production RO gateway on host `starlink-prd-blockblast-ro-1` as Kong service `starlink-s2s-gateway-kong-1`.
- Other components: `starlink-sentry`, `starlink-airflow-prd`, `uc-starlink-hfrog-minio-registry`.

## Environments & Domains

- Public domains: `starlink.youxi123.com` (public gateway, resolves to 106.75.64.81), `starlink.hs99.vip` (production), `starlink-alpha.youxi123.com` (alpha).
- Inner VPC gateway: `starlink-inner.youxi123.com` resolves to 10.9.144.217.
- Internal read-only GraphQL: `https://starlink-ro-internal.youxi123.com/gql/` (resolves to 10.9.79.82).
- Dev environments served at `*.d.hs99.vip` (K8s) and `*.t.hs99.vip` (series), managed by Cloudflare DNS.
- URL conventions: `https://{env}-{game}.hs99.vip` for Compose, `https://{game}-{env}.t.hs99.vip` for K8s.
- All live starlink domains use wildcard `*.youxi123.com` TLS certificate (valid 2026-01-23 to 2027-01-22).
- DNS managed in `hs99.vip` zone on Cloudflare.

## Services & Components

- Core services: BBC (Python backend), GQL (Rust GraphQL, `wirerope-gql`), frontend (SolutionHub), starflow, ding (OpenResty gateway), hfrog, pgpour (CDC), vector, redis, starlai, fakeuser, asyncmon, rustyme, staroriginweb, openresty, nginx, attachments, lowcodegql, bff.
- Frontend apps: block-blast, block-mahjong, mahjong-wonders, block-crush.
- Containers named `starlink-{user}-{game}-{service}-1`; users: lhh, dwb, lgh, lby, wz, yl, yy, mx, lxy, lsx, kwd, hyx, cyx, dev.
- Docker images built by Jenkins from git.7k7k.com, tagged `{BUILD_TYPE}-{APP_ID}-{branch}-{commit}`.
- Helm charts: `starlink-bbc`, `starlink-rustyme`, `starlink-attachments`, `starlink-lowcodegql`, `starlink-atomkit`, `starlink-redis`.
- Jenkins folder on `devops-jenkins.hs99.vip` contains jobs for frontend, bbc, gql, db-migrator, etc.

## Databases

- Each game/environment cell has two PostgreSQL databases: `{env}_{game}_client` and `{env}_{game}_codekeeper`.
- Dev all-in-one RDS: `starlink-dev-all-in-one.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (PostgreSQL 16.13), hosts many client/codekeeper DBs (e.g., `lgh_blockmj_client`, `yy_blockblast_client`, `dwb_blockcrush_client`, `pm1_dev_client`).
- Alpha RDS: `archteam-starlink-alpha-pg.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com:5432`.
- BlockCrush PRD RDS: `archteam-starlink-blockcrush-pg16.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (database `prd_blockcrush_client`).
- BlockBlast prod RDS: `pgm-2zevk26j83oa40t4.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com:5432` (alias `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`), databases `hs_code_keeper_db`, `hs_client_db`. Superuser `postgres` (password YSYwtoeUwsQjLIvq1), app user `starlink_user` (password l8DrBC5GdTa7DT). Read replicas: `pgr-2ze00ogh570nd336` (alias `archteam-starlink-blockblast-prod-ro.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`), `pgr-2zee76956a0bqp6f`.
- Merge prod RDS: `pgm-2zehh591176h9svz` hosts `prd_merge_client` and `prd_merge_codekeeper`.
- Gogoblast prod RDS: `archteam-starlink-gogoblast-prd.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com:5432` (ID `pgm-2zevdzevrmf9l651`).
- Shared-services RDS: `archteam-starlink-prd-shared-services.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com` (database `fework_prd_db` with tables `app_info`, `app_login`, etc.).
- Old UCloud PostgreSQL at 10.9.177.238:5432 still in use as of 2026-06-25, hosts `hs_client_db`, `hs_code_keeper_db`, `n8n_alpha_db`, `hs_frog`, `n8n_db`, `starl_ai_db`, `hs_staff_db`.
- Dev UC internal PostgreSQL: `starlink-dev-uc-internal.hs99.vip:5432` (10.9.114.160, PG 16.10, superuser `solutionhub_dev`).
- Credentials stored in `e.credentials/starlink/` (e.g., `shared.txt`, `blockblast.txt`, `merge.txt`).

## Kafka & CDC

- Kafka clusters: dev at 10.9.169.2:9092, 10.9.131.68:9092, 10.9.103.246:9092 (plaintext); production at 10.9.73.159:9092, 10.9.7.152:9092, 10.9.136.40:9092 (cluster `ukafka-1lx9hnxqiple`).
- Topic naming: `starlink.{game}.{env}.{schema}.{table}` (e.g., `starlink.blockcrush.lgh.public._pm_idea_details_enriched`).
- Feature config workflow topic: `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public.feature_config_workflow_info`.
- Outbox topic: `biz.starlink.{game}.{env}.public._pm_idea_flow_outbox_event` (table `_pm_idea_flow_outbox_event`).
- CDC pipeline: PostgreSQL → pgpour → Kafka → Vector → PostgreSQL, with Airflow → Starmap downstream.
- Blockblast dev CDC streams from `dev_blockblast_client` to topics prefixed `starlink.blockblast.dev`.
- Production topics use `prd` (not `prod`) in names.

## Storage

- Uses MinIO (server 10.254.3.107) and Aliyun OSS.
- Artifacts stored in MinIO, migrating to OSS.
- Two-bucket architecture per game (private and public).
- Buckets: `starlink-blockcrush-pm-artifacts`, `starlink-jdmj-pm-artifacts-public`, `starlink-artifacts-prd`.
- Credential file: `e.credentials/starlink/pm-artifacts-oss.txt`.
- Attachment paths stored as relative URLs: `/attachments/{key}/{filename}`; nginx routes to starlink-attachments service.

## Deployment & CI/CD

- Deployments via `deploy-multiapp` Ansible playbook or Helmfile.
- Jenkins jobs: `starlink` folder contains `gql`, `bbc`, `frontend`, `db-migrator` jobs.
- Production ECS hosts store `GQL_IMAGE_TAG` in `/data/starlink-{game}-prod/.env`.
- Dev deployment matrix: 14 developer environments, 6 games, each as Docker Compose stack.
- Prod deploys require allowlisted user.
- Onboarding new game is manual runbook involving schema seed, `target_envs.yml`, Jenkins choices, `starlink-envs`, compose dirs, Kafka topics, DNS/SSO, and Atlas diff.

## Access & Management

- Managed via JumpServer (`jump.hs99.vip`); hosts named `archteam-starlink-*`.
- Permission rule `archteam:starlink:starlink` grants 6 users access to 44 hosts with @ALL accounts and full actions.
- Production hosts use `osadmin` account with SSH key access.
- User has kubeconfig files for Alibaba Cloud ACK starlink dev and prod clusters.
- Local project at `/Users/liguanghui/hs.projects/starlink`.

## Data & Schema

- Domain model: Solution → Way → Tag → Feature → Asset.
- `feature_config` table stores `feature_name`, `feature_desc_rich`, `pre_experiment_level`, `idea_dimension` (TEXT[]).
- `feature_tag_config` and `feature_tag_config_history` track feature tag config and edit history.
- `solution.tag` is JSONB array linking to `feature_tag_config.id`; `feature_tag_config.feature_list` links to `feature_config.feature_id`.
- `feature_config` enforces unique constraint on `(platform, feature_id)`; proposal sync uses `proposal.id` as feature_id, external/UI uses `fc.id`.
- `update_status` API uses field `is_ignore_completes` (not `is_include_completes`) and supports `limit` parameter.

## Other

- Starlink is a cost group in Aliyun `caikuai-cn` account; monthly cost ~¥12.9K–13.2K.
- Uses Aliyun EventBridge and OSS; hook endpoint at `starlink-jade-mahjong.youxi123.com`.
- APP_ID: `starlink_pm`.
- SSO Client ID 1181083881 stored in `fework_prod` database.
- Starlink prod SSO apps typically `access_everyone: true`.
- API endpoints: `/flow/v1/yunxiao/links/tag/async-update`, `/api/fc/ai_so/kafka/update_status`, `/api/fc/ab_3/kafka/update_status`.
- Starlink CLI at `/Users/admin/bin/starlink` with `get solutions` command.
